meta.model: t = (1 + s_p) t_true + a_p in the LOCAL tan (stage-3 tanx/tany); corrected t' = (t - a_p)/(1 + s_p). Equivalently on GLOBAL slopes S = g_p t: S' = (S - g_p a_p)/(1 + s_p). Tilt a = grad(phi) (potential), phi a tensor cubic B-spline; per-view scale s_x, s_y tensor cubic B-splines.
meta.coefficients: phi, s_x, s_y: nb x nb arrays indexed [i_x][i_y]; basis B_i(u) uniform cubic, knots lo + k h; evaluate with apply_r3.tensor_eval (a_x = d phi/dx, a_y = d phi/dy, x = x_local, y = y_local in mm)
meta.signs: g = local-tan -> global-slope sign per view (x, y): A (+1,+1), C (+1,-1), D (-1,+1), as t6lib.G and map_view.slope_sign
meta.edges: positions clamped to [lo, hi]; fields then clamped to [min, max] over the supported region (clamp block); NaN positions: no correction
meta.built_by: W2a_map_r3/build_maps.py (r3lib.Spline), training: lines.parquet / bd_lines.parquet clean lines (t6lib.rows_ac / rows_d)
meta.variant: candidate r3: A, C lines-only penalised spline (potential tilt + per-view scale); D the same model fitted to the B-D lines + horizontal capsule pointing cells (nuisances alpha, gamma, kappa per chamber, not applied: maps[D].fit.pointing)
meta.status: PROTOTYPE from test W2a_map_r3 (2026-11-24); not in any product
meta.validation: r3_validation.csv; held-out by run parity on cosmic lines, beam pointing (beam_*.csv)
meta.pointing: A, C: not used (task 2: no held-out gain on cosmics; cross-check only). D: used (fit.pointing)

A.frame: x view -> d_x/d_z, y view -> d_y/d_z (global); local x_local = +x, y_local = +y

support.rule: 10 mm grid point whose 20 mm cell holds >= 3 clean training lines

A.clamp_rule: [0.1, 99.9] percentile of the field over the clean training lines

C.frame: x view -> d_x/d_z, y view -> d_y/d_z (global); local x_local = -x, y_local = +y

support.rule: 10 mm grid point whose 20 mm cell holds >= 3 clean training lines

C.clamp_rule: [0.1, 99.9] percentile of the field over the clean training lines

D.frame: x view -> d_z/d_x, y view -> d_y/d_x (global); local x_local = -z, y_local = +y

support.rule: 10 mm grid point whose 20 mm cell holds >= 3 clean training lines

D.clamp_rule: [0.1, 99.9] percentile of the field over the clean training lines
